content:
anya (AE): FYI — EnterpriseZ signed LOI, need final commit sizing + onboarding plan. they asked for 95th-pctl latency < 250ms and 99% availability.

lina (Solutions Eng): Congrats. what's their traffic profile? bursty or steady?

anya (AE): bursty. expected 60k req/day, peaks ~550 RPS for 5–10m, median ~30 RPS. typical prompt avg 120 tokens in, 60 tokens out.

carl (SRE): rough estimation: with current GPT-like model on A100* nodes, ~= 0.9 RPS per GPU for that prompt length if single-stream. but we can batch — effective throughput ~6–10 RPS/GPU depending on batching window.

josh (Sales Eng): They want reserved capacity with burst credits. Can we recommend a commit and burst mix?

lina (Solutions Eng): Suggest reserved baseline for 200 RPS steady -> ~25 GPUs (conservative), plus autoscale pool for bursts up to 600 RPS -> extra 40 GPUs on reserve/burst. But with aggressive batching + quantization we can cut GPUs ~30%.

anya (AE): Pricing question from them: how do reserved vs burst billing work? need quarterly commitment numbers for CFO.

josh (Sales Eng): Reserved = monthly committed $/GPU-hour. Burst = metered at higher unit rate; we offer pre-warmed burst credits per contract month. I'll draft numbers after Lina confirms GPU count.

marco (Customer): quick note — security questionnaire says we must use customer-managed KMS and VPC peering for private deploy. is dedicated + private possible with the commit?

carl (SRE): Private deployment increases onboarding time and may reduce burst elasticity. We can offer Dedicated within their VPC via Private control plane, SLA still possible. Need SOC/ISO docs — ops-bot can post links.

ops-bot: Documentation links: https://redwood/example-soc2, https://redwood/private-deploy-onboard-checklist

lina (Solutions Eng): Two technical blockers to flag: 1) KV cache persistence across nodes — for long chat sessions we recommend sticky routing or shared cache to avoid regen cost. 2) Some models need 16-bit quantization testing for quality; we should run small evals.

anya (AE): timeline: customer wants POC next week and production in 6 weeks post-POC. can we pre-provision?

carl (SRE): We can pre-warm a subset of reserved pool 48h before POC. For production ramp, recommend staged rollout + canary in two AZs. Add preheat cron: `preheat --pool enterpriseZ --window 48h`.

lina (Solutions Eng): Action items: 1) I'll run quantization evals on their prompt set (need sample prompts). 2) Carl will draft preheat/autoscale policy template. 3) Josh/Anya to provide pricing sketch for commit + burst credits.

anya (AE): I'll pull the prompts and send to Lina by EOD. Marco — can you share the security questionnaire PDF?

marco (Customer): sending now, thanks. attaching in email.

josh (Sales Eng): I'll create the commit pricing worksheet and ping legal for contract language about burst credits.

lina (Solutions Eng): One more note: recommend model fallback policy — if quantized variant misses quality, fallback to FP16 model for top 5% high-value requests. reduces risk.

carl (SRE): Agree. Also propose 10% runway buffer in GPU commit for AZ failures.

anya (AE): Great. let's reconvene after Lina's eval and Josh's pricing draft. thanks all :thumbsup:
